items.title: Halftime: Sparks 47, Mercury 44. Rae Burrell’s steal and score sends Los Angeles into the break on a high note. Dearica Hamby has 13 points on a perfect 6-for-6 shooting. Sparks shot 46% and forced 11 Phoenix turnovers, resulting in 12 points.
